authority: Project owner explicitly requested proceeding with a computational substitute for the human-review dependency on 2026-09-05.
purpose: Permit evidence-bounded draft development while independent human review remains outstanding.

source_access.scope: Only source checks for the named draft objects. This is a new bounded development authority, not execution of the frozen July acquisition plan.

review_requirements: Exact versioned draft and source bindings
Source identity separated from mechanistic applicability
Explicit challenge review with context and model provenance
Evidence-linked adjudication preserving objections and narrowed scopes
No unsupported promotion from metadata or cofactor agreement to full mechanism
Reproducible structural checks and adversarial regression tests
Unresolved objections block affected operations rather than every unrelated draft
supersession: This policy replaces the human-only development prerequisite for new versioned source-scoped drafts. It leaves the July Phase B review contract, independent-annotation commitments, protected registries, and evidence-tier definitions intact.
